It is   that a perusal of the aforesaid bail order clearly reflects t  petitioner has not been named in the First Information Report  submitted that the petitioner is a chronic patient of Cancer   therefore, the attachment of the petitioner to the office of   Commissioner, Gwalior is going to cause serious detriment to   petitioner's health.
Issue notice to the respondents by RAD mode on payment  process fee within 7 working days, returnable within 4 weeks.
